credits.title: The Child
credits.overview: The story of Mariaje and Nicasio, the mother and grandfather of one of the children who died in a gas explosion in a town in the Basque Country in October 1980. On a journey marked by unexpected emotions, Mariaje and Nicasio search for - and find - their own unique way to overcome their loss.

credits.title: Es normal
credits.overview: Sofía goes to her family doctor because she continues to have severe menstrual pain. The results indicate that everything is fine and normal, but the normality lies in the paternalistic tone and treatment she receives from her doctor, Martín. And to make matters worse, she receives the same treatment from the viewer.
